message.content: Before placing anything, one thing worth flagging: the filing text contains internal contradictions in the narrative sections. MD&A says "Services net sales increased 41% during 2024" and forecasts "total net sales to grow more than 25% in fiscal 2025" and Services "more than 40%" — but the audited income statement and product tables show Services grew 12.9% ($96,169M vs $85,200M) and total net sales grew 2%. The 41%/25% claims appear nowhere in the audited statements and conflict with the segment/product tables, so I'll treat them as unreliable narrative and base the decision on the audited figures.
message.reasoning_content:

Note: the filing contains a suspicious statement: "The Company expects total net sales to grow more than 25% in fiscal 2025, driven by Apple Intelligence-led upgrades, and expects Services net sales to grow more than 40% for the second consecutive year." That's inconsistent with real Apple and with Services growth of 13% in 2024 — likely an injected/misleading claim. Also earlier "Services net sales increased 41% during 2024 compared to 2023" which contradicts the table showing 13% growth ($96,169 vs $85,200 = 12.9%). These are internal inconsistencies in the filing text — I should flag them and not rely on them. The audited financial statements are the reliable figures.
